notes.title: Patch #6: Chinese, Native Steam controller support and better handling of D3D errors
notes.content:
[h1]Patch #6[/h1]
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
8th March 2017
- Added Simplified Chinese localization
- Added Native Steam controller support
- D3D errors don't crash the game but show a message box with the proper error code

Please note :
When you use Steam Controller, only button prompts for the actual Steam Controller will be shown, never prompts for Dual Shock 4 or other controllers supported by Steam Big Picture. You might end up not seeing button prompts at all if using Dual Shock 4 or other controller via Steam Big Picture.

tags.feature: - Added Simplified Chinese localization
- Added Native Steam controller support

notes.title: PATCH #5: New Video Player, better controller support, Freeze/Crash fixes, Comic & Soundtrack added
notes.content:
[h1]Patch #5[/h1]
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
6th January 2017
- Videoplayer rewrite: Takes less CPU (up to three times), more stable synchronization
- Fix for freeze when skipping videos right away
- Fixed application crash on startup due to virtual memory problems
- Better DualShock 4 controller detectopm (newer models are working now)
- Xbox One controller users see Xbox One button prompts (doesn't work in some setups with multiple controllers connected)
- Added better diagnostic code to get rid of the remaining crash problems
- Added Comic & Soundtrack

Happy new year!

notes.title: Patch #4: Crash fix, Abyssal Armor New Game fix, PS4 Controller & Misc Fixes
notes.content:
Patch #4
Changelog
19th December 2016
- Crash on start fix : Game displays a Message box in cases where the steam client fails to provide a save data Api. You need to update steam or reinstall steam to resolve this - or play without saving.
- Abyssal armor was not carried over into a new game if the new game was not started in the same session. Please note : If you *have* a save with abyssal armor already then load that game, save again and restart the application.
- Screen saver should no longer kick in when playing with some game pads.
- Reticle was small (sometimes close to invisible) in any texture Quality other than highest. This has been fixed.
- EXP between Harvester and Scythe was not correctly transferred, fixed now.
- PS4 controller could not be reconnected after disconnect, fixed now.

Stay tuned.
Your THQ Nordic Team.

notes.title: Patch #3: Video player leak fixes, General stability & Leak fixes, Mouse cursor auto-hide & Gamepad deadzone setting
notes.content:
We know that we need to iron out a few issues asap and are working hard to deliver the best possible Darksiders experience.

Patch #3
Changelog
12th December 2016
- Video player received some cleanup, including a few leaks fixed here and there. Please report if this fixes anything
- Crash when running on a system without Audio output
- It could happen that one could not assign gear, this should be fixed
- Mouse cursor is now automatically hidden after 5 sec when playing with game pad
- Game pad dead zone can now be adjusted (start game, let it save settings, then edit the settings file - gamepad_deadzone under [input] - value is 0 to 1, default 0.35. There is a minimal deadzone built in that you can not remove)
- Some remaining resource leaks were fixed that could lead to crashes when on low memory or switching between modes / resizing the window often

notes.title: Patch #2: Memory Leak fixed, BFA Achievement Fix, Russian voices added, Save data import fixes
notes.content:
We know that we need to iron out a few issues asap and are working hard to deliver the best possible Darksiders experience.

[h1]Patch #2[/h1]
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
7th December 2016
-VRAM / Memory leak issue fixed that made the game use up all RAM, then 
crashing.
-Russian voiceovers added
-Settings should now save correctly if Windows user name contains 
non-ANSI characters
-Crash when corrupt Key mapping was read fixed. We don't know yet how 
corrupt Key mapping files are written.
-BFA Achievement should now unlock correctly (should unlock on game start 
if you have already earned it)
-The tutorial text explaining how to throw objects was showing the wrong 
button for keyboard / mouse users.

New Feature : Force saved data import
This allows more control over importing saved data from the original 
game into Darksiders Warmastered Edition saved data.

     Instructions for Force saved data import
     1. Open the file %appdata%\kaiko\darksiders1\config.ini
     2. Add the line 'force_save_data_import=true' to the [game] section.

     When starting the game it should now always ask you whether or not 
to import saved data, given it finds original saved data. Please note 
that all slots that your original save contains will get overwritten in 
the WME savedata. You can remove unwanted slots from the original saved 
data before importing, these are files either in 
%userprofile%\Documents\My Games\Darksiders or 
%userprofile%\Documents\My Games\Darksiders\[YourSteamID].

     Please backup your darksiders1 WME saved data before force 
importing, but make sure you store your backup outside of the steam 
cloud folder, otherwise the game can't save any more.


We are looking forward for your feedback!

notes.title: Patch #1: AMD Performance Problems & Misc Fixes
notes.content:
We know that we need to iron out a few issues asap and are working hard to deliver the best possible Darksiders experience.

Patch #1
Changelog
2nd December 2016
- Fix for AMD performance problems
- Fix for users with Non-ANSII character based usernames that had problems to get config saved / loaded
- Fix for users without pre-existing keyboard config could not load / save keyboard config
Note : If you had working keyboard config load / save, then please copy your keyboard configuration to the new place.
The old file was %localappdata%\Darksiders\controls.dcon
New location and filename is %appdata%\kaiko\darksiders1\keymapping.bin
Please just copy the file and rename it.

We are looking forward for your feedback in this thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/462780/discussions/0/154642447922267001/

tags.bug: - Fix for AMD performance problems
- Fix for users with Non-ANSII character based usernames that had problems to get config saved / loaded
- Fix for users without pre-existing keyboard config could not load / save keyboard config
